thesis: Control Magic converts the opponent's best creature into both removal and a threat, producing a two-for-one as long as the Aura survives.

playbook.role: Steal a creature whose immediate board impact justifies exposure to enchantment removal. Sacrifice outlets and protection can prevent the opponent from regaining it at a decisive moment.

counterplay.directAnswers: Destroy or bounce the Aura, sacrifice the creature in response, or avoid investing all pressure in one stealable threat. Enchantment removal becomes a tempo swing because it both answers Control Magic and restores the creature.
